aboutus.banner.desc: Shandura nzvimbo yako yekugara nemakapeti edu eumbozha, uko maitiro uye nyaradzo inopindirana mune yega fiber.
aboutus.desc: Tikugashirei kuAl-Barkaat Overseas, uko tsika inosangana nehunyanzvi munyika inoyevedza yekufukidza pasi. Kuda kwedu machira kwakadzika midzi mune yega yega, uye isu tinodada zvikuru nekukupa iwe yakasarudzika yakarongedzwa emhando dzakasiyana dzemarape akanaka anoratidza humbozha, nyaradzo, uye hupfumi hwetsika. Kunyangwe iwe uchitsvaga kupinza nzvimbo yako nekudziya kwetsika, kukwezva kwedhizaini yemazuva ano, kana musanganiswa unopindirana wezvose zviri zviviri, machira edu akagadzirwa kuti apfuure kushongedza chete uye kuve anokosheswa nhaka mumba mako kana muhofisi. Pinda munzvimbo umo hunyanzvi hunosangana nenhaka, uko zvigadziriso zvisingagumi zvinorukana pamwe nehunyanzvi hwemazuva ano - tsvaga ragi rakakwana rinoenderana neyako chimiro uye kukwidziridza nharaunda yako yekugara kuAl-Barkaat Overseas.
aboutus.service1: Kufumura Kukosha Kunoshamisa: Chinangwa chedu chinoenderana nekupfumisa ruzivo rwako kuburikidza nemitengo yemakwikwi, kukurudzira kudyidzana, uye kuendesa sevhisi isingaenzaniswi.
aboutus.service2: Kukwidziridza Kunaka: Rwendo rwedu rwakamiswa mukutsvaga kusingachinji kwekukwana. Nekuzvipira kwakasimba kune innovation uye kuzvipira kusingazungunuke pakuona kugutsikana kwako kukuru, tinoedza kutsanangura patsva mabhenji eindasitiri. Sangana nesu sezvatinotanga rwendo rwekuenda kune ramangwana rakajeka, rakabudirira.
aboutus.service3: Kumbundikira Zvisingaperi Mikana: Chiono chedu chinotambanukira kunze kwenzvimbo sezvatinombundikira zuva rega rega tichizara nemikana mitsva yekukura nekushanduka. Yakatsaurirwa kune ramangwana rinokurudzirwa nehunyanzvi, kufambira mberi, uye kugona kusingaperi, tinokukoka iwe kuti ubatane nesu mukugadzira rondedzero yamangwana.
aboutus.service4: Kugadzira Kukosha, Kuona Kunaka: Isu tinodada zvakanyanya mukuzvipira kwedu kukupa iwe mimwe yemitengo inokwikwidza muindastiri. Kutsvaga kwedu kusinga peri kwekudhura-kugona uye hunyanzvi hwekutsvagisa kunotibvumira kuwedzera mari yakawanda kwauri. Isu tinotenda zvakasimba kuti kukwanisa hakufanire kukanganisa kunaka kwesevhisi kana zvigadzirwa zvaunogamuchira. Nokudaro, isu tinochengetedza tarisiro isingazununguki pakuunza kukosha kusingaenzaniswi uye kugona.
